51556076.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GST-tagged human SPOP MATH domain (28 to 166 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 CodonPlus (DE3)-RIPL cells assessed as equilibrium dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Compound E1 disrupts SPOP^MATH–substrate interactions by binding to SPOP^MATH. (A) Determination of compound E1 binding to SPOP^MATH via an SPR experiment. Graphs of equilibrium unit responses versus E1 concentrations are plotted. (B) Inhibitors competitively inhibit binding of puc_SBC1 peptide to SPOP^MATH, as measured by the FP assay. Error bars represent mean ± SD of three independent experiments. (C,D) Compound E1 disrupts protein binding between GST-SPOP^MATH and Myc-PTEN (C) or Myc-DUSP7 (D), as measured by an in vitro GST pull-down assay.
